headline: Austin robotaxi fleet hits 52 active vehicles + 38 Cybercabs in test fleet; unsupervised ride rate surges to 59% — up from 27.8% on May 6; operational maturity accelerating sharply; 23 of 39 rides last 7 days completed with no safety driver; Cybercab test fleet size doubling signals imminent commercial integration (robotaxitracker.com)

EU FSD bloc-wide approval confirmed July at earliest, October more realistic — TCMV has no vote scheduled this week; Tesla needs representatives of 15/27 EU member states AND 65% of bloc population to vote yes; Nordic regulators (Sweden, Finland, Denmark, Norway) raised concerns over FSD allowing speeding and hands-free driving on icy roads at Brussels session; Tesla's internal target of Q2/Q3 2026 EU-wide approval now under material uncertainty (Reuters / Ars Technica / Automotive World)

TSLA gains +2% to ~$420 on May 8, outperforming S&P 500 by +2.43% — stock recovering toward March 2026 highs as traders monitor FSD China approval timeline; intraday range $402–$415 with momentum building into the afternoon session; dark pool call flow remains 2.5:1 vs puts signaling continued institutional accumulation (TheStreet / Investing.com)

Tesla recalls 218,868 US vehicles over rearview camera software delay — software bug in update 2026.8.6 caused delayed or blocked rearview image for up to 11 seconds when shifting into reverse, violating NHTSA rear visibility standards; all affected Model 3, Y, S, X units already received OTA software fix; no dealership visit required; market shrugged off recall — stock gained 2% on the day (Reuters / Teslarati / NHTSA)

Tesla begins internal testing of FSD v14.3.2 in China — first concrete testing milestone after repeated regulatory delays; Q3 2026 approval now cited as official target after missing Q1 and Q2 windows; Tesla building Baidu HD map integration per Beijing requirement that foreign firms not conduct independent HD mapping in China; only partial public-road test authorization held; China represents Tesla's largest untapped FSD subscriber market (eletric-vehicles.com / letsdatascience)

Tesla unsupervised robotaxi fleet hits 33 vehicles with extended evening hours — six new vehicles added in a single day across Austin, Dallas, and Houston; Austin now running driverless rides past 4pm for the first time; Drive Tesla Canada notes growth curve 'beginning to resemble classic slow-then-all-at-once exponential scaling'; fleet at 38+ per NextBigFuture (Austin: 27, majority of 53 total); trajectory accelerating ahead of Cybercab production ramp (Drive Tesla Canada / robotaxitracker.com)

Tesla Roadster reveal now targeting late May or early June 2026 — delayed from Musk's 'month or so' hint on Apr 23 earnings call; represents the 8th delay since 2017 per Electrek; new USPTO trademark filings (May 1) with stylized badge signal Tesla locking down Roadster visual identity ahead of imminent reveal; production deliveries remain 2027+ (topelectricsuv.com / Electrek)

EU FSD adoption surges — Dutch users alone drive 10M km in first month after Netherlands RDW approval; one city in one country generating more FSD miles than most national fleets combined; signals explosive European subscriber uptake ahead of summer EU-wide vote; Tesla ending one-time purchase option in Netherlands May 15, funneling new EU owners into €99/month ARR pipeline

SpaceX formally files plan revealing Terafab chip factory costs $55B–$119B — joint Tesla/SpaceX semiconductor facility in Texas enters formal planning phase; research fab at Giga Texas (~$3B) will produce AI5-class chips in small batches; full Terafab scope $55B minimum with total exceeding $119B; Intel 14A process confirmed; SpaceX filing notes 'no assurance' on timeline execution; one of the largest private infrastructure investments in history if fully built

Germany April 2026 best April ever for Tesla — 3,149 units, 1.3% overall market share, 4.9% of BEV segment; BEV national penetration hit 25.8%; +256% YoY vs April 2025, +142% vs January 2026; highest first-month-of-quarter since Q1 2024 (9 quarters); YTD already at 82% of full-year 2025 total; last 3 months +188% vs Nov–Jan; EU recovery now structural across all major markets
